contentHtml:
We have effective treatment for cancer and tumor.  In a week time the pain will come under control. Even if the painkillers are not effective in controlling the pain, our treatment is effective and pain will come down considerably in a week time. In a month’s time size of tumor/cancer comes down considerably and in three months time the patient will improve much. If the Doctors are of the opinion that the patient will not live for more than few weeks or month, such cases too our treatment helps them to recover. If the patient is able to eat and drink normally or they can take at least 50% of their normal food and drinks, we can treat them, otherwise it is difficult.  You can do this treatment alone or along with chemotherapy or radiation.  Normally we will admit the patients for at least one month, the duration depends upon how fast they are recovering.

Our treatment for cancer and tumor include Panchakarma therapy, internal medication (very specialized and rare Ayurvedic medicines), external application of Ayurvedic medicine etc..  according to the patient’s condition. This treatment will gradually remove the pain, infections and inflammations.   Multiplication speed of cancer cells will come down and gradually cancer/tumor will disappear.  We will do our best to save the patient.

Our special offer to Cancer patients:

We are even ready to give treatment and medicines free-of-cost for one week. If you found it effective, you can make the payment and continue the treatment; otherwise there is no need to pay for that period.  We will not charge anything for the treatment, medicine, room rent or food that we had given to the patient. A scan just before starting the treatment and on 7th day may help you to evaluate the progress.  The size of the cancer/tumor will reduce within this time.   You can evaluate the progress accordingly. Normally within this time the patient’s condition will become much better, and you can continue the treatment if you like. Our treatment aims to improve the immune system of the patient while controlling the multiplication of cancer cells. Inflammation and infection in the affected area gradually decrease. Panchakarma treatment will helps in   removing the  toxins from the body. It is our promise that we will do everything possible to give the patients a chance to return to  normal life. You can have our treatment even at the time of taking Chemotherapy. Effectiveness of chemotherapy is often limited by toxicity to other tissues in the body. Radiation can also cause damage to normal tissue. Removal of the cancer cells without damaging the rest of the body is the goal of our treatment. We can’t guarantee the life of any person, we are sure that our treatments may help you to recover from cancer quickly. Our medicines will act very fast and may be able to save your life. There must be someone close to the patient to attend the patient full heartedly. If we are able to save the life of a person, that will be the best thing that we can do for them.

If we detect cancer in time and gives Chemotherapy or radiation therapy, it will save you.  But what we are watching daily is, even though the patient is saved from first attack, after some years there is possibility to come back again.  Normally we will come to know about it in a later stage and it may spread to other parts of the body.  In  such cases some times chemotherapy may not be  able to save the patient.    Sometimes you may be chemotherapy resistant, in such cases too, our medicine will work and may help you to recover at the earliest.  Our request is please do not waist even a single day, if possible start the treatment today itself, every second is valuable,   try to save the life first.

This is highly cost effective comparing to Chemotherapy and other treatments.  It is free from side effects.  It boosts the immune power of the patient and protects them.

Some patients do not like to undergo chemotherapy,  we all heard that some people do not like to harm their beauty, their beautiful hair, or face.  In case of breast cancer they are compelled to remove the breast, because there is no other option is left.  Some people do not like such operation and removing a part of body.   In such cases the patient is dying every day.  Our treatment is a blessing to them.  Our treatment will not harm the body; they will not loss their hair or a part of body.

Every cancer patient can try our medicine.   Even if you are planning to undergo operation or chemotherapy, some times there is a time gap, you have to wait for few days, in such cases too you can try our treatment in that time gape, you can assess the efficacy of our treatment.

Case studies

In our experience we treated many patients having multiple cancers spread to different parts. We will share some of our experience with you.   One of our patient had cancer spread to  brain, liver lungs, uterus and bone, she was under chemotherapy and at the same time taken our medicine,  within two months she improved much, her  lungs, brain and liver  become normal.    A Lymphoma  patient’s scan report is quoted here for a comparison. The first scan was done three months and nine days (101 days) back and the report says that  “it is an inhomogenously enhancing mass with areas of necrosis with in it, measuring approximately 9.8cm x 9.1cm x 15.6cm.” after 80 days they come to us.  Before that they tried some other medicine, but the patient’s condition was deteriorating daily.  From the internet they come to know about our treatment, they come to us.  We treated the patient as an inpatient for 21 days, we had  a scan there after, in that report it shows that “The lesion is more protruding in to left hemithorax measuring 7.8cm x 5.6 cm”  If we compare these two scan reports we can understand how much effective is our treatment.

What is cancer?

Cancer  is a broad group of diseases characterized by  unregulated  (uncontrolled) cell growth. In cancer, cells divide and grow uncontrollably, forming malignant tumors, and invading nearby parts of the body.  When the damaged cells divide uncontrollably that may form lumps or masses of tissue called tumors.  Cancer may spread to other parts of the body through the lymphatic system or bloodstream.  There are more than 200 different known cancers that affect humans.

We provide highly effective Ayurvedic treatment for all types of cancer, whether it is single or multiple. Our treatment is highly effective even in case the cancer spread to different organs/parts. We have treatment for different tumors too. In cases of cancer or tumors sometimes it is very risky to undergo operation.

Medicine

We are using pure Ayurvedic/herbal/natural medicines for the treatment of Cancer and tumor. Normally Ayurvedic medicines do not have any side effects, at the same time giving additional side benefits to you. We have our own special medicines, and prepare medicines according to the requirements of the patients.  Medicines vary with condition of the patient.  We have our own Medicine Manufacturing unit, having GMP Certificate.  We use quality materials for the manufacture of these quality medicines.

 Benefits of our treatment

  1. Normally patients will feel much better in one or two weeks.  They will feel relaxed and their mind becomes more peaceful.
  2. You may recover much faster than your expectations.
  3. More than 90% people will not feel any pain  and related problems with in 3 or 4 weeks.  Others may take some more time.  The speed of recovery depends on many factors including the severity of the problem, the stage, where it is affected, the age of the patient, how long the patient is suffering from this problem  etc..
  4. If you are not interested in chemotherapy or radiation and you think, that will affect your beauty, you can have our treatment which is fully protecting your body and beauty,  the hair, skin, color etc.. may become better.
  5. Our medications for Cancer and Tumor will help to remove toxins, inflammation, infection, stiffness etc.. and destroy cancer cells.
  6. Our treatment increase the blood supply in the affected parts and the cells will get more oxygen and nutrients and this helps to rebuild the affected parts and helps to stop further spreading.
  7. In case of chemotherapy, patient’s immune power is losing and gets infections.  Infection is the main cause of death while doing chemotherapy.  In our treatment your immune level is increasing and there is no such chance for infections.  Our treatment is good in controlling infections.
  8. You can have our treatments while undergoing chemotherapy as well,  this will help the patient to protect to a certain extent from the side effects of chemotherapy and help to speed up the recovery..
  9. You will regain your total health and you can have a normal life.
  10. In our treatment there is no risky operation or like that.  It is 100% safe and protects your health.

Duration of the treatment

Normally the patient have to undergo the therapy for three to five weeks, others may take some more time. Everybody have to continue the medications for at least three years.
